name: MetaDragon token-id transfer unrestricted minting
summary: P404Token treated any transfer value below 30,001 as an NFT id; sending one to the token contract burned that NFT through the linked collection without an ownership check and minted 9,800 tokens to the caller. A bot first burned one holder's NFT; the main attacker then burned thousands and sold the mints into the MetaDragon/WBNB pair.
notes: The NFT collection only lets its registered p404contract burn; setP404Contract pointing it at this token (9 blocks after the token's deployment) is the latest change the exploit needed, so it is the reset.

The anchor is a bot's (0x7edaf26b) CREATE2 helper burning NFT #1 of holder 0x0f143ae1 and selling the mint, 14,000 blocks before the main attacker's twelve transactions. Loss is the pair's WBNB outflow over all thirteen.
